talk.title: Beyond the Screen: Building for Android XR
talk.description:
Your wrist buzzes. A message from a friend. You pull your phone from your pocket and call him back: Let’s go for lunch!. You jump into your car, buckle up, and tap the dashboard to set the route. You arrive early. While waiting for your table, you notice a game playing on the TV, sit down, pull out your tablet, and check the live stats.

All these screens share one foundation: Android, seamlessly powering everyday moments.

Now, a new form factor joins the lineup: XR headsets. With Android XR, you can break free of 2D boundaries and build deeply immersive spatial experiences using the tools you already know and love: Jetpack Compose and modern Android APIs.

Join me for a practical dive into Android XR. We’ll explore the core spatial paradigms and see exactly how to bring your existing Compose skills and apps into this new dimension!

speaker.name: Carlos Mota
speaker.title: Lead Software Engineer at Avancee Software
speaker.bio: Carlos Mota is an Android GDE. He can easily be spotted either working on Android applications written in Kotlin or developing them along with Kotlin Multiplatform. An enthusiastic about new technology and always trying to reach those last 20% of all of his side projects that seem to be really far away. He loves to share his knowledge with others either by giving talks, teaching, writing, or along with a cold beer in the nearest pub. GDG Coimbra organizer and Kotlin evangelist, he also has a huge passion for travel, photography, space, and the occasional run.
